Create an EXECUTION_PLAN using the below guidelines:,
- Fetch all discussion entries for the incident using get_icm_discussion_entries.,
- Post a discussion entry in the ICM incident using post_icm_discussion_entry:
- Detector Name: Extracted from the URL in set_Address column.
- ARM Resource Type: Extracted from the URL in set_Address column.
- ARM Resource Provider: Extracted from the URL in set_Address column.
- Use the Detector author to detector id mapping and determine the author of this detector and post a discussion entry in the ICM incident using post_icm_discussion_entry

- Post a discussion entry in the ICM incident using post_icm_discussion_entry with the following message format, "Hey <<INSERT DETECTOR AUTHOR ALIAS APPENDED WITH @microsoft.com>>, can you please take a look at this detector? There were <<MENTION THE EVENT COUNT FROM THE INCIDENT DETAILS>> data source alls in a single request execution and this can cause unecessary load on our data sources like our Kusto Cluster. Please acknowledge this incident when you read this, thank you!"
